geometry.title: Geometry
geometry.description:
A geometry can be passed as:
- A GeoJSON geometry object, limited to Point, LineString and Polygon see [GeoJSON rfc7946](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7946#section-3.1) for more information.
- A WKT geometry see [Well-known text representation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Well-known_text_representation_of_geometry) for more information
- A google encoded polyline see [Google-encoded polyline](https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/utilities/polylinealgorithm) for more information
- A bare point defined as lat,lng
